overall.summary: WDC's post-Separation 10-K shows meaningful disclosure degradation in several areas that cannot be fully attributed to the removal of Flash business content. While the Separation legitimately eliminates Flash Ventures, Kioxia partnership, and flash memory supply chain disclosures, the company has also reduced transparency on HDD-specific cost/margin details, human capital metrics, customer concentration risk context, and tax position specifics. The most concerning pattern is the combination of dramatically increased customer concentration (68% top-10, three customers >10%) with reduced qualitative risk discussion about that concentration.
